paragraphs: R. Yehudah bar Simon, in R. Yehoshua ben Levi's time—I do not know the basis. Rabbah, Devarim; VeZot HaBerakhah nearby; Reeh; beginning of Tavo has bar Sima. Jerusalem Megallechin, end of halakhah 5: R. Simon in R. Yochanan's name, etc. R. Yirmeyah stood with R. Yehudah bar Simon and said, “All R. Yochanan's students say no one heard this matter from him except your father.” R. Yaakov said, “If it was said, it was said only on the basis of these teachings,” since R. Simon said in R. Yehoshua ben Levi's name, etc. R. Abba bar Yudan, in his name. R. Aivu bar Nagri. R. Berekhiah, his son. R. Chunya, in his time. In R. Yehudah bar Ilai's name. R. Yehoshua ben Beitim, in his name. [The checked Bereshit Rabbah reads ben Baytus.] In R. Yosi ben Nehorai's name. R. Kohen. In R. Levi's name: Tanchuma, end of Mishpatim. [The checked passage there gives Yehudah bar Shalom. Devarim Rabbah gives Yehudah bar Simon in Levi’s name on a different subject.] In R. Levi son of R. Tarfon's name. R. Lulinus the Southerner, in his name. In R. Nehorai's name. R. Azaryah, in his name. R. Perozdiri bar Nachsha, in his name. He taught it in Karna's Nezikin [נזקין דבי קרנא]: Bava Kamma 47b. [The checked Bavli names the teacher Rav Yehudah bar Simon.] R. Shalom, in his name. In R. Shimon ben Elazar's name: Shir HaShirim Rabbah, on “Show me your appearance.”
